messages.subject: CPF | Global food systems, sustainability and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear CPF Executive Leadership Team,

CPF's global food system and sustainability agenda create a strong fit with my experience leading ESG, government relations and social-performance execution in a multinational operating environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role connects senior leadership with ministries, regulators, communities and strategic partners across a complex resource operation.

I bring practical experience translating sustainability commitments into operating action, including community engagement, renewable-energy transition, carbon-data governance and cross-functional accountability. I would bring CPF a country-facing leader who understands how responsible growth depends on both institutional trust and measurable execution.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or international roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a CPF-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
